metadata.question: Does Pacific Palisades have higher tropospheric Nitrogen dioxide levels on January 9, 2025 than on January 12, 2025?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-5P NO2 Level 3 datasets over a 5 km buffer around Pacific Palisades, CA (Point: -118.535, 34.048). Query daily collections for 2025-01-09 and 2025-01-12. First try OFFL; if empty, fallback to NRTI.
2. Masking strategy: Mask pixels with qa_value < 0.75. This is standard for TROPOMI quality.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: Count valid pixels after masking. If count == 0, output C2. If any mean is null/NaN, output C3. If no images exist for a date in both datasets, output C1. Catch exceptions => D.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to evaluate ee objects as Promises
  const getInfo = (eeObj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.evaluate((v, err) => (err ? reject(err) : resolve(v))));

  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([-118.535, 34.048]); // Pacific Palisades approx center
    const region = point.buffer({distance: 5000}); // 5 km buffer
    const date1 = '2025-01-09';
    const date2 = '2025-01-12';
    const scale = 3000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    console.log('Region: Pacific Palisades (5km buffer)');
    console.log(`Dates: ${date1} vs ${date2}`);

    // Precompute a baseline pixel count at this scale for valid-fraction estimates
    const ones = ee.Image(1);
    const totalCount = await getInfo(
      ones.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels,
      }).get('constant')
    );

    // Function to compute daily mean NO2 with QA masking; with dataset fallback
    async function dailyNO2Mean(dateStr) {
      const start = ee.Date(dateStr);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'day');

      const baseSelect = ['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value'];

      const offl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select(baseSelect);

      const nrti = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/L3_NO2')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(region)
        .select(baseSelect);

      const offlSize = await getInfo(offl.size());
      const nrtiSize = await getInfo(nrti.size());

      let usedCol = null;
      let usedTag = null;
      if (offlSize > 0) {
        usedCol = offl;
        usedTag = 'OFFL';
      } else if (nrtiSize > 0) {
        usedCol = nrti;
        usedTag = 'NRTI';
      } else {
        return {
          status: 'C1',
          offlSize,
          nrtiSize,
          usedTag: 'None',
          mean: null,
          count: 0,
          validPct: 0,
        };
      }

      const maskedCol = usedCol.map((img) =>
        img.updateMask(img.select('qa_value').gte(0.75))
      );

      const daily = maskedCol.mean();

      const count = await getInfo(
        daily
          .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: maxPixels,
          })
          .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
      );

      if (!count || count === 0) {
        return {
          status: 'C2',
          offlSize,
          nrtiSize,
          usedTag,
          mean: null,
          count: 0,
          validPct: 0,
        };
      }

      const mean = await getInfo(
        daily
          .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
          .reduceRegion({
            reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry: region,
            scale: scale,
            maxPixels: maxPixels,
          })
          .get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
      );

      // compute valid fraction relative to sampling grid
      const validPct = totalCount && totalCount > 0 ? (count / totalCount) * 100 : 0;

      // Check for invalid mean
      if (mean === null || Number.isNaN(mean)) {
        return {
          status: 'C3',
          offlSize,
          nrtiSize,
          usedTag,
          mean: null,
          count,
          validPct,
        };
      }

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        offlSize,
        nrtiSize,
        usedTag,
        mean,
        count,
        validPct,
      };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Checks
    const r1 = await dailyNO2Mean(date1);
    console.log(`${date1} Images -> OFFL: ${r1.offlSize}, NRTI: ${r1.nrtiSize}, Used: ${r1.usedTag}`);
    if (r1.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('No images found for first date.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (r1.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('No valid pixels after QA for first date.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (r1.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('Calculation failure for first date.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const r2 = await dailyNO2Mean(date2);
    console.log(`${date2} Images -> OFFL: ${r2.offlSize, r2.offlSize}, NRTI: ${r2.nrtiSize}, Used: ${r2.usedTag}`);
    if (r2.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('No images found for second date.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (r2.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('No valid pixels after QA for second date.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (r2.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('Calculation failure for second date.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing Evidence
    const fmtMean = (v) => (v === null ? 'null' : Number(v).toExponential(2));
    const fmtPct = (p) => `${p.toFixed(1)}%`;
    console.log(`${date1} Mean NO2: ${fmtMean(r1.mean)} mol/m^2, Pixels: ${r1.count}, Valid: ${fmtPct(r1.validPct)}`);
    console.log(`${date2} Mean NO2: ${fmtMean(r2.mean)} mol/m^2, Pixels: ${r2.count}, Valid: ${fmtPct(r2.validPct)}`);

    // 4. Validation & Final Answer
    const m1 = Number(r1.mean);
    const m2 = Number(r2.mean);
    if (!isFinite(m1) || !isFinite(m2)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const diff = m1 - m2;
    console.log(`Difference (Jan 9 - Jan 12): ${diff.toExponential(2)} mol/m^2`);

    if (m1 > m2) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
